name: Dr Jhatka Medicare Editorial Team
bio:
Dr Jhatka Medicare Editorial Team is a team of qualified Physiotherapists and healthcare professionals dedicated to providing accurate, evidence-based, and patient-friendly medical information. The team specializes in Home Physiotherapy, Post-Surgery Rehabilitation, Knee Pain, Back Pain, Stroke Rehabilitation, Women's Health Physiotherapy, and Geriatric Care.

Every article published by Dr Jhatka Medicare is medically reviewed to ensure trusted healthcare guidance for patients and families in Lucknow.
